name: Project Creation Restriction
description:
The Project Creation Restriction app is designed to help administrators control and restrict which users have the ability to create projects in Odoo. Using a simple boolean option, admins can enable or disable project creation for individual users. This feature ensures that only authorized users can create projects, which is useful in organizations that need to maintain strict control over project creation. When a restricted user attempts to create a project, they will receive a pop-up warning message indicating they do not have the necessary permissions.

        Key Features:
        1) Restriction on Project Creation:
           - Admins can toggle the "Restriction on Project Creation" option to prevent specific users from creating projects.

        2) User Access Control:
           - Control who has the ability to create projects by assigning the permission settings to individual users or user groups.

        3) Error Message:
           - Restricted users will see an error message or warning pop-up when attempting to create a project.

        Use Cases:
        - Restrict the project creation process to only authorized users, such as managers or administrators.
        - Prevent unauthorized users from creating projects, maintaining control over project setup and management.

        Supported Views:
        - Navigation: Settings ➡ Users & Companies ➡ Users ➡ Restriction on Project Creation (Boolean option).
        - Pop-up View: Restricted users will see a warning message when they attempt to create a project.

name: All in One Lock Price
description:
The Lock Price module in Odoo enables managers to set fixed prices for products, preventing any changes to the price in sales orders, purchase orders, invoicing, and accounts. This ensures that product prices remain consistent across different stages of the sales and purchase cycle, providing greater control over pricing and preventing unauthorized adjustments.

        Key Features:
        1) Lock Price for Users:
           - Managers can enable the "Lock Sale, Purchase, Product, and Account Price" Boolean option to lock the product prices for specific users, ensuring no modification.

        2) Read-Only Price in Product View:
           - When the price is locked, users can only view the locked price in the product view, making it impossible to edit.

        3) Price Lock in Sale Orders, Purchase Orders, and Invoicing:
           - Locked prices will appear as read-only in sales orders, purchase orders, credit notes, bills, and refunds, maintaining price integrity across transactions.

        Use Cases:
        - Ensure that product prices are consistent and prevent any unauthorized price changes.
        - Control pricing during transactions across multiple Odoo modules.

        Supported Views:
        - Navigation to lock product prices:
          * Product View: Sales → Products
          * Sales Order View: Sales → Quotations
          * Purchase Order View: Purchases → Requests for Quotation
          * Invoicing View: Invoicing → Bills and Credit Notes
